ayahs.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ عَادٍ أَخَاهُمْ هُودًا ۗ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ
ayahs.translation_en: And to the people of Aad, We sent their brother Hud. He said, 'O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him.'

ayahs.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ عَادٍ أَخَاهُمْ هُودًا ۚ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ ۖ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا مُفْتَرُونَ
ayahs.translation_en: And to Aad, We sent their brother Hud. He said, 'O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. You are not but inventors of falsehood.'

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.translation_en: When their brother Hud said to them, 'Will you not fear Allah?'

ayahs.arabic: وَيَا قَوْمِ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوا إِلَيْهِ يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
ayahs.translation_en: And O my people, ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. He will send rain from the sky upon you in showers.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِن قَوْمِهِ إِنَّا لَنَرَاكَ فِي سَفَاهَةٍ وَإِنَّا لَنَظُنُّكَ مِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ
ayahs.translation_en: Said the eminent ones who disbelieved among his people, 'Indeed, we see you in foolishness, and indeed, we think you are of the liars.'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ لَيْسَ بِي سَفَاهَةٌ وَلَٰكِنِّي رَسُولٌ مِّن رَّبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'O my people, there is not foolishness in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds.'
'Do you build on every height a monument for amusement?'
'And you take for yourselves constructions that you might live forever?'

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً
ayahs.translation_en: As for Aad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, 'Who is greater than us in strength?'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ قَدْ وَقَعَ عَلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ رِجْسٌ وَغَضَبٌ
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'Already have defilement and anger fallen upon you from your Lord.'

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ عَارِضًا مُّسْتَقْبِلَ أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ قَالُوا هَٰذَا عَارِضٌ مُّمْطِرُنَا ۚ بَلْ هُوَ مَا اسْتَعْجَلْتُم بِهِ
ayahs.translation_en: And when they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys, they said, 'This is a cloud bringing us rain!' Rather, it is that for which you were impatient.

ayahs.arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا لَا يُرَىٰ إِلَّا مَسَاكِنُهُمْ
ayahs.translation_en: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen except their dwellings.

ayahs.arabic: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَانِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا
ayahs.translation_en: Which He imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا هُودًا وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا
ayahs.translation_en: And when Our command came, We saved Hud and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us.
